descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will ensure that all purchased materials and services meet ABB standards by qualifying suppliers, monitoring performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve world-class results.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings / Supplier Business Excellence & Development in Schaffhausen, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

-
Supplier Qualification & Audits: Qualify and approve new suppliers and conduct regular process, system, and product audits.

-
Quality
• Requirements & FAI: Define and communicate quality requirements and lead First Article Inspections and qualification processes.

-
Performance Monitoring & Improvement: Track supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., PPM, OTD) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

-
Non-Conformance Management: Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective actions (8D/CAPA).

• Qualifications for the role

-
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent professional experience

-
Good knowledge of English and German (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus

-
Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits (ISO 9001, VDA 6.3, IATF 16949 or similar)

-
Knowledge of APQP/PPAP and First Article Inspection (FAI)

-
Strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis methods (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa)

-
Understanding of statistical quality methods (SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R)

-
Knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and material/component specifications

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

-
Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

-
REKA credit

-
Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

-
Parental leave

-
Fitness allowance

-
Eco bonus

More about us
ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
ABB Smart Buildings consente l'ottimizzazione dell'efficienza energetica, della sicurezza, della sicurezza e del comfort per qualsiasi tipo di edificio, attraverso nuove installazioni o soluzioni retrofit. La Divisione offre tecnologie digitali integrate per il controllo di HVAC, illuminazione, tapparelle e sicurezza, oltre a soluzioni di distribuzione dell'energia, tra cui prodotti della guida DIN, custodie e illuminazione di emergenza attraverso tappi industriali e prese e accessori di cablaggio convenzionali, accomunati per singole case familiari, abitazioni multiple, edifici commerciali, infrastrutture e applicazioni industriali. Le tecnologie e le soluzioni digitali altamente innovative della Divisione servono ad aumentare la domanda globale tra sviluppatori immobiliari, proprietari e investitori per tecnologie di costruzione intelligente che ottimizzano la distribuzione energetica e l'automazione degli edifici. Le soluzioni scalabili mirano a fornire significativi benefici sostenibili e finanziari, soddisfare le esigenze sociali e ambientali, pur essendo in grado di affrontare anche le più complesse strategie di riduzione del carbonio dei clienti.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Ecco perché accogliamo le persone da tutti gli sfondi e le esperienze.

Qualification des fournisseurs et vérifications : Qualifier et approuver les nouveaux fournisseurs et effectuer des vérifications régulières des processus, des systèmes et des produits.

Qualité
• Exigences & FAI: Définir et communiquer les exigences de qualité et diriger les inspections et les processus de qualification du premier article.

Plus sur nous
ABB Smart Buildings permet d'optimiser l'efficacité énergétique, la sécurité, la sécurité et le confort pour tout type de bâtiment, grâce à de nouvelles installations ou à des solutions de modernisation. La Division offre des technologies numériques intégrées pour contrôler le CVC, l'éclairage, les volets et la sécurité, en plus des solutions de distribution d'énergie, y compris les produits de rail DIN, les boîtiers et l'éclairage de secours, grâce à des prises et prises industrielles et des accessoires de câblage conventionnels, pouvant accueillir des maisons individuelles, des logements multiples, des bâtiments commerciaux, des infrastructures et des applications industrielles. Les technologies et solutions numériques hautement innovantes de la Division répondent à la demande mondiale croissante des promoteurs immobiliers, des propriétaires et des investisseurs de technologies de construction intelligentes qui optimisent la distribution d'énergie et l'automatisation des bâtiments. Les solutions évolutives visent à fournir des avantages durables et financiers importants, répondant aux exigences sociales et environnementales, tout en étant en mesure de répondre même aux stratégies de réduction du carbone les plus complexes des clients.
